verdict.rationale: ImageMagick is an image-processing CLI and library, not an AI agent or host application. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in external servers to use their tools is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP client or tool-consumption capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
